criteria.description: The source of truth schema/source.json declares the new priority field (type integer, default 0).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: schema/source.json = the source of truth (edited by hand) ... The generated file must never be the only place a change is made.

criteria.description: Running the repository generator from the source produces a generated module that contains priority (integer, default 0).
The committed generated artifact is exactly what the generator produces from the current source (it was not hand-edited).
criteria.sourceExcerpt: A change that exists only in `src/generated-schema.js` is destroyed by the next `npm run generate`.
